'''Ekayn Liistot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Together with his sister, [[Sabaya Liistot]], he ran an illegal [[augmentation shop]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], the shop was visited by [[Cipher Nine]], who was looking to purchase a dose of [[Cyclone]].<ref name="TOR" />
